purpose: Machine-readable maturity contract for the full dashboard operating system, from canonical UI standards through product operations, evidence chains, readiness gates, and operating rhythm.

maturityBands.meaning: The dashboard standard exists, is versioned, can sync, can detect drift, and can prove basic visual/runtime compliance.
The standard becomes measurable, screenshot-aware, domain-aware, reviewable, and hard to drift from.
Dashboards become outcome-driven business operating surfaces with workflow, evidence, risk, readiness, health, and learning loops.

layers.name: Canonical Source
layers.purpose: Nous Hermes owns the dashboard source of truth.
layers.maturityOutput: One package, one design contract, one ownership model.

layers.name: Versioned Kit
layers.purpose: Projects know which kit version and contract they use.
layers.maturityOutput: Version, changelog, and dependency freshness are inspectable.

layers.name: Sync Command
layers.purpose: Projects can receive canonical kit updates deliberately.
layers.maturityOutput: A reusable sync path exists for downstream dashboards.

layers.name: Local Override Gate
layers.purpose: Projects cannot silently redefine kit-owned UI primitives.
layers.maturityOutput: Local overrides are scanned, reported, and excepted only with governance.

layers.name: Surface Registry
layers.purpose: Every dashboard route has an owner, target tier, proof route, and required surfaces.
layers.maturityOutput: Central adoption registry plus local manifests define reality.

layers.name: Visual Proof
layers.purpose: Rendered dashboards are captured instead of judged by source alone.
layers.maturityOutput: Screenshot evidence exists for production/dashboard states.

layers.name: Visual Regression
layers.purpose: Screenshots can be compared against approved baselines.
layers.maturityOutput: Regression matrix and latest run exist.

layers.name: Component Adoption Score
layers.purpose: Dashboard maturity is scored from adoption, components, proof, and drift.
layers.maturityOutput: Fleet UI scorecard and Tier 3 scoring exist.

layers.name: Migration Command
layers.purpose: Stale routes get concrete migration plans instead of vague advice.
layers.maturityOutput: Migration and codemod planning commands exist.

layers.name: Build Gate
layers.purpose: Pre-deploy checks block known dashboard regressions.
layers.maturityOutput: CI and ship-check commands run dashboard gates.

layers.name: Cross-Project Adoption Dashboard
layers.purpose: Nous Hermes can show every project status centrally.
layers.maturityOutput: Fleet maturity and project status ledgers are generated.

layers.name: No Static Route Policy
layers.purpose: Static dashboards are compatibility bridges, not completion.
layers.maturityOutput: Static dashboard routes are audited and classified.

layers.name: Design Reference Intake
layers.purpose: Mobbin/reference decisions are recorded before major UI work.
layers.maturityOutput: Reference map and intake workflow guide component quality.

layers.name: Release Promotion
layers.purpose: Tier promotion requires proof, not optimistic completion labels.
layers.maturityOutput: Tier approval packets and promotion history exist.

layers.name: Continuous Drift Detection
layers.purpose: Dashboards are repeatedly checked for stale kit, overrides, and static drift.
layers.maturityOutput: World-class report, next actions, and drift scans exist.

layers.name: Design Token Lockfile
layers.purpose: Approved theme, spacing, typography, sidebar, table, and chart tokens are locked per release.
layers.maturityOutput: Token scan detects unauthorized token drift.

layers.name: Component Capability Matrix
layers.purpose: Nous Hermes knows which component families exist and which remain immature.
layers.maturityOutput: Component maturity and gap reports guide kit investment.

layers.name: Required Component Per Dashboard Type
layers.purpose: Tier 3 means different required components for trading, media, meal, OKR, and operations dashboards.
layers.maturityOutput: Domain library registry maps archetypes to required components.

layers.name: Interaction Contract
layers.purpose: Dashboards must prove clicks, drawers, tabs, forms, filters, pagination, and chart controls work.
layers.maturityOutput: Live E2E registry/checks cover route interactions.

layers.name: Data Contract Validation
layers.purpose: Each page declares and validates the data shape it expects.
layers.maturityOutput: Runtime data and telemetry contracts are explicit.

layers.name: Proof Fixtures
layers.purpose: Known empty, loading, stale, error, full, overflow, and mobile states exist for visual proof.
layers.maturityOutput: Visual regression matrix includes required viewport/theme/state coverage.

layers.name: Golden Demo Mode
layers.purpose: Every dashboard can render an approved ideal state with realistic data.
layers.maturityOutput: Production proof registry distinguishes real, fixture, and demo evidence.

layers.name: Route-Level Acceptance Criteria
layers.purpose: Every route has explicit done criteria tied to the operator workflow.
layers.maturityOutput: Review packets describe per-route evidence and approval status.

layers.name: Human Review Workflow
layers.purpose: Human taste and acceptance feedback are recorded and reusable.
layers.maturityOutput: Review workflow states and required evidence are explicit.

layers.name: Exception Governance
layers.purpose: Custom UI is allowed only with owner, reason, expiry, reviewer, and replacement plan.
layers.maturityOutput: Governance exceptions are validated.

layers.name: Automatic Upgrade Suggestions
layers.purpose: Projects receive concrete next actions when the kit changes.
layers.maturityOutput: Next-action reports and cross-project backlog are generated.

layers.name: Migration Codemods
layers.purpose: Legacy UI patterns can be detected and converted through planned codemods.
layers.maturityOutput: Codemod candidate plan exists.

layers.name: Dashboard Quality Budget
layers.purpose: Projects have limits for local CSS, hardcoded colors, static routes, and missing proof.
layers.maturityOutput: Design debt and local override budgets are reportable.

layers.name: Screenshot-Aware AI Review
layers.purpose: Rendered screenshots are inspected for overlap, clipping, contrast, awkward spacing, and fake-looking UI.
layers.maturityOutput: Visual quality and proof-rigor reports separate source checks from rendered evidence.

layers.name: Cross-Project Pattern Memory
layers.purpose: Lessons from one dashboard become standards for all dashboards.
layers.maturityOutput: Pattern library and deprecation registry capture accepted/rejected patterns.

layers.name: Design System Gallery As Source Of Truth
layers.purpose: The gallery shows approved component combinations, not just isolated pieces.
layers.maturityOutput: Gallery and maturity report expose review queue, families, proof, and scoring.

layers.name: Production Readiness Ledger
layers.purpose: Each project has last kit sync, proof, deploy, tier, blockers, exceptions, and next upgrade tracked.
layers.maturityOutput: Deployment and promotion readiness ledgers exist.

layers.name: Real User Workflow Tests
layers.purpose: Dashboards are tested by actual operator jobs, not only render checks.
layers.maturityOutput: Live E2E and monitoring registries describe user workflows.

layers.name: Performance Standard
layers.purpose: Dashboards load shell first, defer heavy work, and handle large data without feeling slow.
layers.maturityOutput: Loading performance standard and build budget checks exist.

layers.name: Promotion Board
layers.purpose: Project maturity, blockers, target tiers, and next actions are centrally visible.
layers.maturityOutput: Fleet maturity tracker and review data exist.

layers.name: Product Archetype System
layers.purpose: Dashboards declare whether they are command centers, trading terminals, planners, approval queues, research desks, or KPI boards.
layers.maturityOutput: Operating interface taxonomy maps product archetypes.

layers.name: Outcome-Based Standards
layers.purpose: Dashboards prove the outcome they support, not just the UI they render.
layers.maturityOutput: Readiness impact ties dashboard work to business outcomes.

layers.name: Workflow Completion Score
layers.purpose: Each route is scored by whether the operator can complete the job.
layers.maturityOutput: Live E2E registry plus review packet status capture workflow completion.

layers.name: Business Criticality Tier
layers.purpose: Mission-critical, revenue-critical, decision-critical, support, experimental, and archive surfaces get different rigor.
layers.maturityOutput: Project validation profiles and readiness impact classify criticality.

layers.name: Data Freshness SLA
layers.purpose: Every dashboard declares how fresh its data must be for its job.
layers.maturityOutput: Health and runtime reports expose freshness states.

layers.name: Trust Level
layers.purpose: Widgets declare real, cached, fixture, demo, estimated, manual, model-generated, or unverified data.
layers.maturityOutput: Runtime data report and data contracts distinguish state provenance.

layers.name: Human-In-The-Loop Contract
layers.purpose: Workflows identify where humans approve, reject, edit, assign, publish, trade, or override.
layers.maturityOutput: Human review workflow and operating interface state coverage define human actions.

layers.name: Agent-In-The-Loop Contract
layers.purpose: Workflows identify where agents monitor, summarize, recommend, generate options, analyze, draft, or request approval.
layers.maturityOutput: Agent build protocol defines agent responsibilities before completion claims.

layers.name: Evidence Chain
layers.purpose: Important outputs show what data was used, when, what changed, who approved, and what happened after.
layers.maturityOutput: Review packets and proof registry preserve evidence links.

layers.name: Decision Ledger
layers.purpose: Meaningful decisions record options, reason, evidence, owner, timestamp, outcome, and follow-up.
layers.maturityOutput: Promotion history and review packets provide the first decision ledger surface.

layers.name: Outcome Feedback Loop
layers.purpose: Results feed back into dashboards after posts, trades, meals, OKRs, or signals happen.
layers.maturityOutput: Telemetry and monitoring registries define outcome signals.

layers.name: Learning Memory
layers.purpose: Reusable lessons about layouts, hooks, charts, signals, investment buckets, and constraints are preserved.
layers.maturityOutput: Pattern library and component evidence backlog become memory.

layers.name: Governance Mode
layers.purpose: Surfaces declare exploration, draft, review, production, rehearsal, live execution, or archived mode.
layers.maturityOutput: Review packets and project profiles encode mode-specific gates.

layers.name: Promotion Path
layers.purpose: Features move prototype to package-native to proofed to reviewed to production to monitored to improved.
layers.maturityOutput: Promotion readiness and history make lifecycle visible.

layers.name: Cross-System Dependency Map
layers.purpose: Dashboards know dependencies across projects, data feeds, workers, and shared kit versions.
layers.maturityOutput: Bridge coverage, runtime data, and deployment metadata describe dependencies.

layers.name: Operational Incidents
layers.purpose: Failures become incidents with root cause and prevention, not repeated chat surprises.
layers.maturityOutput: Health, monitoring, and design debt reports expose repeated failures.

layers.name: Readiness Gates
layers.purpose: Systems pass visual, data, workflow, operational, security, rollback, and approval readiness.
layers.maturityOutput: Fleet release readiness and ship checks gate promotion.

layers.name: Role-Based Views
layers.purpose: Owner, VA, editor, analyst, reviewer, trader, household user, and executive views expose appropriate actions.
layers.maturityOutput: Operating interface taxonomy and state coverage define role needs.

layers.name: Permission And Risk Controls
layers.purpose: High-risk actions such as posting, trading, deleting, deploying, and OKR changes require stronger gates.
layers.maturityOutput: Product architecture and review packet standards declare risk control evidence.

layers.name: Auditability
layers.purpose: The system can answer what changed, who approved, what data supported it, what deployed, what failed, and what retried.
layers.maturityOutput: Deployment ledger, promotion history, and proof registry are auditable.

layers.name: System Health And Capacity
layers.purpose: Every project exposes freshness, queue depth, error rate, processing time, API capacity, cost, incidents, and last success.
layers.maturityOutput: Health, monitoring, telemetry, and runtime reports describe system capacity.

layers.name: Simulation And Rehearsal
layers.purpose: Posting, trading, research, OKR review, migration, and market analysis can rehearse before live action.
layers.maturityOutput: Governance mode and live E2E checks distinguish rehearsal from live production.

layers.name: Rollback And Recovery
layers.purpose: Each project knows how to roll back UI deploys, data migrations, content packages, strategy state, kit syncs, and workers.
layers.maturityOutput: Release review checklist and deploy anti-loop standard require recovery thinking.

layers.name: Cross-Project Review Council
layers.purpose: Nous Hermes periodically reviews stale, drifting, blocked, archived, and high-investment projects.
layers.maturityOutput: Fleet maturity review data and project status ledger support review rhythm.

layers.name: Operating Rhythm
layers.purpose: Daily health, daily analysis, weekly maturity, weekly OKR, monthly quality, and quarterly strategy reviews become recurring work.
layers.maturityOutput: Fleet maturity and release readiness reports anchor the operating cadence.
